findings.title: PTR-based allowlist bypass: squid dstdomain matches IP-literal CONNECTs through the reverse name
findings.fix: Render '-n' on every dstdomain ACL (categories and denied_domains) so an IP literal never matches a category by its PTR. Add a render test asserting -n on every dstdomain, a system/sandbox probe that an IP-literal CONNECT per port and per pool returns 403 with no proxy DNS packet, and an ADR-0005 addendum.

findings.title: Squid resolves every requested hostname, including denied ones (DNS exfiltration via the proxy for 3140, 3150 and the fetch/llm sandbox pools)
findings.fix: Evaluate the resolved-IP deny only after a category match: per rule 'http_access allow port_X src_Y cat_Z !denied_dst', or a fast 'deny !<union of the port/pool categories>' ahead of 'deny denied_dst'. Add a probe that a random-label CONNECT per port and per pool leaves the OSSBOT-IN proxy-DNS counter (or squid ipcache) unchanged, a render test that no dst ACL is evaluated before a category ACL, and an ADR-0005 addendum.
